top_signals.title: Gold Rises as US Treasuries Pare Losses Following Fed Rate Hike
top_signals.summary: Gold clawed back some losses alongside Treasuries as markets stabilized following the Federal Reserve’s first interest-rate hike since 2023.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: King Charles to press Nvidia, OpenAI, Anthropic leaders on AI safety at summit
top_signals.summary: Charles will convene senior tech leaders today as the debate around the risks involved in AI development ramps up.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Bitwise CIO Hougan revises Clarity Act outlook, says crypto bull market may continue without legislation
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin climbed above $80,000 in early September despite declining odds of the legislation passing this year, Hougan noted.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Momentum Plans Acquisitions to Grow South Africa Adviser Network
top_signals.summary: Momentum Group Ltd. is seeking to buy businesses as the South African investment and medical-insurance company looks to boost the number of financial advisers and drive sales.
